en.topic_title: Migrant worker activists push back against Hong Kong visa rejections over ‘job-hopping’
en.topic_summary:
Migrant worker activists have pushed back against the government’s rejection of domestic workers’ visas over concerns that they had a history of “job-hopping,” saying that workers have the right to seek better working conditions.



Migrant domestic workers on their day off in Hong Kong, on November 11, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
